_comment: Real SpikeGLX run metadata. imec0.ap (NP2010, four-shank Neuropixels 2.0) is from int-brain-lab/viewephys; sample3B2 (Phase 3B2, Neuropixels 1.0) from int-brain-lab/ibl-neuropixel; sample3 (2016 Phase 3A, before typeThis existed) from flatironinstitute/ironclust. Channel count, sampling rate, sample count and microvoltsPerBit were checked against neo 0.14.6's extract_stream_info on the first two; neo raises KeyError on the 2016 file, which this decoder still describes.
